LanguageData.kon.label: Fox Beast Ear Kon
LanguageData.kon.description:
To find a missing friend in a neighboring village It is a fox animal samurai girl who is exploring the forest. She has few words, but she is kind and compassionate If you persuade her and welcome her into the colony, she will be a reassuring bouncer.
She loves gold and finds it while exploring the outside. A small amount, but you can receive it as an accommodation fee.
